competitive_sourcing.rule: Should normally include at least three comparable offers; a single-source exception requires written Procurement justification.

additional_approvals.approval: Information Security approval before contract signature (security questionnaire and evidence of controls required)
AI Governance review, with documented intended use, affected users, data categories, expected benefits, material risks and human oversight
